result.reason: Neither position is fully met. The clause provides some SFJ IP indemnity and an express defense for SFJ-created infringement, plus indemnity for gross negligence and willful misconduct, but omits breach-of-law and data-breach coverage, most defense duties, and all procedures. It also lacks every stated fallback exclusion, remedy, and the 3× annual-fees super-cap. The drafting is structurally defective: it jumps from subsection (a) to (d), ends with a dangling exception, and places PB-caused breaches and infringement under an SFJ indemnity heading, undermining the intended allocation that each party bears the IP risk it creates.
